subject: Renewal + Upsize: Procurement Lighthouse — PO funnel & attestation triage
messages:
From: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@atlasmed.com>
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@atlasmed.com
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + upsell — vendor onboarding refresh and PO routing

Hi Nikhil / Laura,

Hope you’re both well. We’re getting close to our 7/31 renewal for Atlas Medical Systems and are planning for a 30% capacity increase across our inference workloads. Procurement asked us to refresh the vendor onboarding package and confirm the PO routing options in your procurement portal before we send the formal PO.

What we need from Redwood to keep the procurement queue moving:
- A single evidence bundle (SOC2 attestation excerpt, data handling appendix, and contact for security) we can upload to our portal.
- Confirmation whether a split PO (initial 6-month commit + bridge PO) is supported and how it shows in the portal.
- A signed SOW draft we can attach for legal.

Attaching the draft SOW we prepared (please sign where applicable) and an internal attestation matrix template for you to fill. If possible, can you confirm the above by EOD Wednesday (6/24)? Procurement will escalate otherwise and we’ll lose the renewal cutoff.

Attachments: Atlas_SOW_v2.pdf (draft SOW), Vendor_Attestation_Matrix.xlsx (template)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Amelia Torres
Sourcing Manager, Atlas Medical Systems
amelia.torres@atlasmed.com
procurement@atlasmed.com

From: nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@atlasmed.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + upsell — vendor onboarding refresh and PO routing

Amelia —

Thanks for the clear ask and the artifacts. We can meet your timeline. Proposed approach (we call it the "Procurement Lighthouse" triage so your portal team has a single reference):

1) Evidence binder (owner: Laura) — we will populate the requested rows in the attestation matrix and provide a SOC2 excerpt, encryption key handling note, and the contact for security. We’ll deliver a zip with PDFs ready for upload by EOD 6/24.

2) PO funnel options (owner: Jordan) — Redwood’s portal supports split POs. We’ll document how a 6-month commit + bridge PO shows up in the portal and provide the exact PO line items and committed SKU names your finance team should use so it maps to reporting.

3) Signed SOW (owner: Nikhil) — we’ll push a signed copy of your draft SOW (minor redline to section 3 pricing) by 6/25. If legal needs a DocuSign link, we’ll do that.

Action items / timelines:
- Laura: populate Vendor_Attestation_Matrix.xlsx and return with supplemental PDFs (EOD 6/24)
- Jordan: provide portal PO mapping and a short how-to doc + screenshot (EOD 6/24)
- Nikhil: finalize SOW redline and provide DocuSign link (6/25 morning)

If procurement prefers, we can open a shared evidence folder (we have a secure GDrive workspace) and provide a single uploadable ZIP with a readme for their portal. Also happy to do a 20-minute walkthrough with your procurement/finance folks once materials are uploaded.

We’ll mark this thread with deal id ATL-2026-REN-0091 so it’s easy to surface.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0122

Nikhil / Jordan —

I’ll own the attestation bundle and the SOC excerpt. Plan: I will
- Fill the Vendor_Attestation_Matrix.xlsx with entries for SOC2 type II, data retention policy, and our KMS integration notes.
- Export the SOC2 extract (redacted) and create a one-page security summary for procurement upload.
- Produce a ZIP named REDWOOD_ATLAS_EVIDENCE_20260624.zip with the completed matrix and PDFs.

Estimate: upload-ready by 6/24 17:00 PT. If procurement needs anything extra (sig block from security), I’ll loop in SecurityOps.

Thanks — this is perfect. Procurement confirmed that a single ZIP upload with the filled matrix and a security one-pager will satisfy the evidence gate and avoid escalation. They also requested the PO mapping doc so finance can draft the split PO lines.

Please go ahead with the timelines above. I’ve scheduled a quick 20-minute handoff at 3pm PT tomorrow (6/24) for procurement + finance — invites are out (you should have calendar invites).

Attachments: none (but procurement will download the ZIP from your Drive link once you post it)

Best,
Amelia
